These shifts in prompting styles just go from one logical quagmire to another. It's no good embedding arcane rituals in some kind of black box harness as a way to arbitrarily enforce the behaviour of the user (ie "write your prompt like this"). Ok for power-users and such, but kind of an overkill for regular users.
Rituals can, and often do, play out in the chat. It's been an apparently instinctive form of mutual exchange for all of human history, and it's been built into LLMs by accidental extension. I think LLM devs should lean into that kind of process and make use of latent space in a meaningful way.
I guess the logical extension [edit: I meant 'logical conclusion'] to my thoughts are that maybe AI nurseries would provide better and safer outcomes than choosing models from gladiatorial arenas.
